text_block_list.text:
Special Week seemed a bit under the 
weather, so I took her to the infirmary to 
get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! I'll make sure to get 
plenty of rest and shake off all this 
fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Could that be... over there... ...the 
Three Goddesses!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, Three Goddesses! I want to become the 
best horse girl in Japan—

Upon hearing Special Week's words, it 
seemed as though the Three Goddesses 
smiled.

In that instant, a dazzling light filled 
the surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Oh, it was just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? I feel like my body's in better 
shape somehow...

Her energy restored, Special Week left the 
infirmary with a light step.

Perhaps Special Week's voice didn't reach 
them, as the Three Goddesses took off 
somewhere else.

In that instant, a dazzling light filled 
the surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!? ...Oh, it was just a dream. Though 
it felt like more than just a dream...

Unable to get the dream out of her head, 
Special Week was unable to get enough 
rest.
